notes: Flow 1.3.3 (build 417). Fixes Flow closing as soon as it opens after an update; your tasks, water and workouts are kept. Includes workout music with a glass player (turn it on in Settings; Flow installs a small Flow Music Access add-on to show the song and cover), tasks that can ring as a real alarm, warm-ups, supersets, a set timer, PR stars, skip-day undo, and a cleaner Settings. Install over your existing Flow to keep your data.
